jobs.prompt:
Ticket T-8024 (OWNER TOP PRIORITY): make split ingest self-correcting by wiring the repair engine tools/split-repair.mjs (T-8023, on this branch: ROOT_RULES, collectSplitIssues, autoFix, buildRepairJobs, runRepairLoop, parkedBlockers, detectTestAfterCodeIssues, detectMissingIntegrationIssues, detectSharedFileIssues; read its tests in tests/split-repair.test.mjs) into tools/scope-commands.mjs cmdSplit (~1095-1227).
(1) NEVER refuse a whole stage for ticket-level validation errors. Refactor the ingest so every check that today returns `split refused ...` for ticket-level problems (rejected tickets, acceptance not provable, missing integration / wiring gaps, path refusals except those overridden by --accept-new-path, lane size, checkTicketTree conflicts/ids/deps, change-order stray tickets, test-after-code) produces structured issues via collectSplitIssues instead, inside a validate() function; keep whole-command refusals only for things that are not ticket-level (scope hash changed, ledger exists without --merge, no ledger with --merge, --wire with non-integration tickets, no split jobs at all).
(2) Run runRepairLoop({ maxRepairs, validate, rerun, log }): maxRepairs from a new flag `--max-repairs N` (default 3, 0 disables); rerun(stages, issuesByStage, round) builds repair jobs with buildRepairJobs (same job ids 'split-<stage>' and the same output path docs/scope/split/<stage>.json, prompt with requirement text + failed ticket JSON + exact issues + ROOT_RULES) and runs ONLY those jobs through an injectable deps.runSplit(root, manifest) -> { id } whose default follows defaultRunReview (~1522): dynamic import('./swarm.mjs'), runManifestChecked(root, manifest, () => {}, { maxUsd: 1.5 }) then wait for completion the way swarm.mjs reviewRun does (waitRun in tools/swarm/core-51.mjs if it is importable, else poll the run state); the next validate reads the new run's stage files for those stages and the original run's files for the others. log each round with appendLog({ event: 'split-repair', round, errorsIn, errorsLeft }).
(3) After the loop: ingest the valid tickets exactly as today (ids, ledger write, approval rules unchanged); write parkedBlockers(parked, { runId }) to the project journal with appendEvent from tools/journal.mjs (kind 'blocker') so they show in the inbox; never ingest a ticket that failed validation; if every ticket is parked, write the blockers and exit 1 with a plain report.
(4) Integration tickets in the same loop: a requirement with build tickets and no integration ticket is a 'missing-integration' issue that the repair round asks the worker to add (with ROOT_RULES rule 5); after the loop, any requirement still missing one is parked as a blocker (no manual `scope split --wire` needed; keep --wire working).
(5) splitPrompt (~661) includes ROOT_RULES verbatim (in addition to its current rules, without contradicting them).
(6) Change orders: the `--merge` ingest used after `swarm change` goes through the same loop (stray tickets become 'stray' issues for a repair round, then parked).
(7) Report: the ingest output prints 'repair rounds: N', each round's errors in -> left, and 'parked: K ticket(s)' with one line per parked ticket and the retry command; the inbox shows the parked blockers.
TESTS in a NEW tests/scope-split-repair-loop.test.mjs (copy the fakeRun/gitRepo helpers from tests/scope-split-guards.test.mjs; do not edit that file): an injected deps.runSplit fake worker writes a new run whose stage file fixes the defect: for each of the four defects (future context, same-wave shared file, test in a later stage than its code, missing integration ticket) ingest succeeds after <= 1 round with every ticket in the ledger; with --max-repairs 0 the bad ticket is parked as a journal blocker, the good tickets are in the ledger and no runSplit call happens; a worker that keeps returning the same defect stops (no-progress) and parks; the report shows round counts and parked tickets; a change-order --merge ingest with a stray ticket is repaired or parked, not refused. Update existing tests that asserted a whole-stage `split refused` for ticket-level errors (search tests for 'split refused') to the new behavior, removing only the refusal assertions and asserting the parked blocker instead; list every changed test in notes. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/scope-split-repair-loop.test.mjs tests/split-repair.test.mjs tests/scope-split-guards.test.mjs tests/scope-ingest-*.test.mjs tests/scope-commands.test.mjs tests/scope-root-files.test.mjs tests/ticket-paths-new-files.test.mjs tests/splitter-lesson-55.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
jobs.ignoreTestsReason: These tests import scope-commands for unrelated commands; the coordinator runs the full suite after integration and fixes any that asserted a whole-stage refusal.
